facts.text: Alderaan, located in the Core Worlds, was a terrestrial planet covered with mountains.

evidence.quote: Alderaan, located in the Core Worlds, was a terrestrial planet covered with mountains.

facts.text: During the waning decades of the Galactic Republic, it was ruled by Queen Breha Organa and represented in the Galactic Senate by her husband, Senator Bail Prestor Organa.

evidence.quote: During the waning decades of the Galactic Republic, it was ruled by Queen Breha Organa and represented in the Galactic Senate by her husband, Senator Bail Prestor Organa.

facts.text: Following the rise of Sheev Palpatine's Galactic Empire, Alderaan played a pivotal role in the establishment of the Rebel Alliance, a movement that sought to restore the Old Republic's values, and was one of its earliest supporters.

evidence.quote: Following the rise of Sheev Palpatine's Galactic Empire, Alderaan played a pivotal role in the establishment of the Rebel Alliance, a movement that sought to restore the Old Republic's values, and was one of its earliest supporters.

facts.text: Because of its ties with the Alliance, the planet was destroyed when Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin decided to test the superlaser of the Death Star, a moon-sized battle station developed by the Empire, at full strength.

facts.text: From space, the planet of Alderaan, located in the star system of the same name within the galaxy's Core Worlds, appeared as a blue-green orb enveloped in a white web of clouds.

facts.text: Alderaan was known to the galaxy as "the planet of beauty." Alderaanians were very artistic and lived for this beauty, but the planet still hid treacherous cliffs and forgotten crevasses.

evidence.quote: The local fauna included the Alderaanian wolf-cat, nerfs, and a species of white-winged bird.

facts.text: The cities on Alderaan were carefully designed to respect the natural beauty of their environment.
